sv.title: Mordförsök i Kalix – man gripen
sv.summary: En man i 50-årsåldern har gripits misstänkt för mordförsök i centrala Kalix. Enligt polisen ska mannen ha betett sig hotfullt mot andra – och en person ska ha skadats.

en.title: Attempted murder in Kalix – man arrested
en.summary: A man in his 50s has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder in central Kalix. According to police, the man is said to have behaved threateningly towards others – and one person is said to have been injured.
